ValueNode and Interpreter.visit_ValueNode: a node that evaluates to an already computed value, in place of the number, string and list nodes of the parser (which would need tokens and positions); visit dispatches to it by the class name, as for any node.
run(container, index, should_return_null=False): converts the Python arguments into values of the language, builds the takeElementNode, visits it and converts the result back.
pinned_behavior: typical: element of a list (number or nested list) and character of a string, returned inside a list.
edge: a negative index is not checked and works as in Python; should_return_null returns the null value ('\\n').
invalid: index out of range, index that is not a number and container that is neither a list nor a string print a RUNTIME ERROR line and exit (SystemExit) with the messages of the original.
not_pinned_on_purpose: The context and positions of the values are not observable through run.
